Controls
  • Drag on the sand: aim · 1–6: abilities · Enter/Space: ready
  • Right-drag, Q/E or arrows: orbit · wheel: zoom
  • R or B (controller): retry the round after you've been knocked out
  • Stand next to a knocked-out goer to get Body Toss
  • Esc or P: pause · F: free cam while planning (WASD / drag to pan) · Spectating: [ / ] switch goer, O overview
  • Controller: left stick aim · LB/RB ability · A ready · right stick camera · LT/RT zoom · Start pause
